stem.text: Which statement about the light microscope is correct?

A.text: As the smallest distance to see two points as distinct separate points decreases, the resolution also decreases.

B.text: If the resolution is $220\,\text{nm}$, then a bacterium $0.2\,\mu\text{m}$ in diameter will not be visible.

C.text: If the wavelength of light is $600\,\text{nm}$, then two membranes $300\,\text{nm}$ apart will be visible as two distinct membranes.

D.text: Using visible light of a longer wavelength, such as red light, will improve the resolution.
